name: dsh-profile-daily-candidate
_comment_linkTargets: THE ABSOLUTE MAIN-TREE PATH BELOW IS LOAD-BEARING -- DO NOT 'CLEAN IT UP'.
Both link: targets name D:/DSH/work/dsh-native-daily on purpose. That literal
is the SEARCH STRING the provisioning rewrite looks for: helpers/new-writer.ps1:99
does `$text -replace [regex]::Escape('D:/DSH/work/dsh-native-daily'), ($wt ...)`.
Replacing these with a relative path, a placeholder, or anything
tree-independent makes that replace find NOTHING, and every provisioned writer
silently resolves the MAIN tree while believing it resolved its own -- the
G-SEAM-29 / G-SEAM-36 / G-SEAM-61 trap that has already forced retractions.
It fails SILENTLY rather than loudly, which is exactly why it is written down.
MEASURED 2026-09-20: the needle and both committed targets still match exactly
(case, slashes, no trailing slash) -- verified by extracting the Escape()
argument from new-writer.ps1 and testing each committed target against it.
WHO REWRITES IT: helpers/new-writer.ps1:91-99 copies profiles/daily-candidate
into $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name> and rewrites package.json THERE. The rewrite is
applied to the INSTALLED COPY only; this file is never modified in place.
WHO DOES NOT REWRITE IT, and why that is correct rather than a gap: the
documented operator install (docs/DELIVERY.md:170) copies FROM the main tree
(`cp -r /d/DSH/work/dsh-native-daily/profiles/daily-candidate ...`), so the
main-tree path is already the right value there. The launcher's own
missing-profile path never reaches this file:
apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:93-131 `initializeProfileFromDefault` copies only
the shipped template's BUNDLE LIST, not our link: targets.
So no install path exists that needs a different value, and the committed
value is simply 'the main tree's value' -- which is what it should be.
